title: iEEG_visual
description: This dataset contains electrocorticography (ECoG) recordings from two human participants viewing visual stimuli, including high-contrast vertical gratings and noise patterns with different spatial frequencies and spectral power distributions. Participants fixated on a central dot that changed color at random times. The data were used to study stimulus dependence of gamma oscillations and the relationship between neuronal synchrony, BOLD response, and the local field potential in human visual cortex.
methods_description: Participants viewed images spanning about 25x25 degrees of visual angle on a computer screen while fixating on a central dot that alternated between red and green at random times. Subject 1 pressed a button at each color change, while Subject 2 fixated without manual responses. Stimuli were vertical square-wave gratings (0.16, 0.33, 0.65, 1.3 duty cycles per degree) and noise patterns with k/f^4, k/f^2 and k/f^0 spectra. Raw data are stored in BrainVision format and organized according to BIDS.
